reading.zh: 本层阅读顺序：关系模型与表归属 → 迁移执行器 → outbox 与任务租约表 → 账本表契约 → OSS 对象布局契约 → 投影契约。箭头语义：call 同步调用、event 异步事件、dataflow 数据/投影流、reference 契约引用。
reading.en: Read in order: Relational Model and Ownership → Migration Runner → Outbox and Job Lease Tables → Ledger Table Contracts → OSS Object Layout → Projection Contracts. Arrow kinds: call, event, dataflow, reference.
